admissionInquiry.title: Admission Inquiry
admissionInquiry.description: Represents an inquiry for admission submitted through the website form.

parentName.description: The name of the parent or guardian.

studentName.description: The name of the prospective student.

studentAge.description: The age of the prospective student.

message.description: An optional message from the inquirer.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the inquiry was submitted.

message.title: Contact Message
message.description: Represents a message submitted through the contact form.

fullName.description: The full name of the person who sent the message.

email.description: The contact email address of the sender.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the message was submitted.
